steps: Parked StarterPack Tools (Spear, Dagger) into ServerStorage
generate_mesh Cube prompt for a slender one-handed arming sword (straight double-edged blade, cross guard, round pommel) at 3.2 studs
One capture confirmed the silhouette: tapered straight blade, cross quillons, wrapped grip, round pommel — distinct from dagger/spear
save_mesh persisted the mesh+texture to a durable asset
make_tool wrapped it (single MeshPart Handle) and moved it to StarterPack

recipe.text: Straight one-handed arming sword — distinct profile vs the existing dagger (short) and spears (polearms). Visual via generate_mesh with a SLENDER-specific prompt (per combat learnings), verified with a single capture (clean taper to a point, cross guard, pommel), then save_mesh for Play durability. make_tool used the single mesh as Handle; bind_behavior gives the fast swing timings and bind_hitbox the short-reach moderate-damage hit with server-authoritative cooldown.
